item.title: 'You're just wasting time bro': Sarfaraz Khan's sledging goes viral - Watch
item.summary: Sarfaraz Khan played a key role as India’s substitute fielder against Sri Lanka, constantly chatting with batters from short leg. His sledging appeared to distract captain Dhananjaya de Silva and Niroshan Dickwella, who were dismissed soon after. Sarfaraz told Dhananjaya, “Don't be scared. You are the captain. Come on, bro," as India strengthened their position.
